concept.title: To validate fields
concept.shortdesc: If all the fields are valid, you'll see a success message displayed at the top

ol.li: Click on the Validate button. If any fields are invalid, the field row in the Document pane will be highlighted in red.
Make any corrections to invalid fields as needed and click Validate again to confirm there are no invalid fields.

section.title: Result
section.p: If all the fields are valid, you'll see a success message displayed at the top of the pane. You can now check in your document.
